This maize plot feeds my family, so I must care for it well even though it is small. I will use the FISP coupon this year — I got one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I will buy one more bag of urea if tobacco money allows. I am intercropping with pigeon pea like my neighbors in Balaka, which helps the soil. I cannot afford pesticide even with the armyworm problem, and there is no river near my plot for irrigation, so I just rely on the rains.
